text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Derby,
where the strongest of 
the generation is decided. The one who 
claimed victory was neither Cheval Grand 
nor Duramente.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite his defeat, Duramente declared he 
would run in the Kikuka Sho to prove he
is 
the "strongest." He showed his unyielding 
fighting spirit before Cheval Grand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, seeing her peers deeply 
frustrated by their losses makes Cheval 
Grand acutely aware of the difference in 
passion between them and herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Just how prepared was I...?" Cheval
Grand 
reproached herself for heading into the 
race with half-hearted conviction.
